scientific_integrity: The universal statement is supported by a self-contained proof. Reproducible finite computations support the proof but cannot certify all parameter choices. The second-order gcd collision count is context, not independently claimed as original.
scientific_limitations: The phase-injectivity result applies to periodic binary words with exactly one zero-run and one one-run per primitive period and windows of an integer number of periods. It does not classify arbitrary window lengths or periods with four or more runs; the explicit four-run example exhibits non-injectivity. An equivalent unindexed prior theorem cannot be ruled out.
title: Sparse third-order subsequence fingerprints recover every phase of a two-run binary cycle
